mentions.name: Ideavo
mentions.description: A platform where innovators, founders, and developers can validate their product ideas against real users rather than AI, giving creators whose posts get buried by popularity-driven feeds the visibility and real feedback needed to decide whether an idea is worth pursuing.
mentions.problem: Popularity-driven platforms like Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok only surface the most upvoted, liked, or trending content, leaving regular posters and aspiring innovators without the visibility or real validation they need to know whether their ideas are worth spending time and money on.
mentions.audience: Innovators, founders, and developers looking to validate their ideas against real users
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a platform for innovators, founders, developers to validate their idea against real users (not AI).

evidence.value: I made a platform for innovators, founders, developers to validate their idea against real users (not AI).
